test_title: PYST 65: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following awards is NOT given in the field of dance and music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dronacharya Award.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dronacharya award is given to the outstanding **coaches in Sports**.
 
• The award was **established in 1985.**
 
• The award is conferred by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• **Balachandra Bhaskar Bhagat(wrestling), O.M. Nambiar(athletics), Desh Prem Azad(Cricket)** were the first recipient in 1985. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidas Samman** is a prestigious award in **Art&Culture** field presented by the Government of** Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• First recipient was **Pandit Kishan Maharaj(tabla player)** in 1980-81.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi** was instituted in 1952 by Sangeet Natak Akademi of Music, Dance and Drama.
 
• It comes under the **Ministry of Culture.**
 
• **Mahari Award **is a prestigious honor for **excellence in arts of Odisha.**
 
• It was introduced by Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• It was named after **Mahari dancers** who were historically **temple dancers of Odisha**.
